summary.intent: Design a new split-pane UI layout for a CLI session browser, replacing the table+Enter-for-details flow with an instant detail pane on the right.
summary.outcome: Completed a structured design Q&A session to pin down layout choices: narrow list pane (TIME, CHECKPOINT, AGENT) with bordered detail pane (compact metadata header + scrollable content), inline time/branch filter tabs. Full design mockups were generated as HTML files in the brainstorm directory.

implementation_rationale: Narrow list (~30%) + wide detail (~70%) chosen to maximize space for session detail content
Bordered detail sections (option C) chosen to visually group metadata header vs scrollable content
Inline filter tab row chosen for discoverability over compact chips or stacked layout
Checkpoint filter dropped from filter bar to keep the UI simple
tradeoffs: List pane columns trimmed to TIME, CHECKPOINT, AGENT — tokens and branch moved to detail pane to fit narrow pane
Filter bar limited to time and branch only — checkpoint filter omitted to reduce complexity
50/50 split layout (option B) rejected in favor of 30/70 to give more room to session details
